query.text: 请帮我照看宝宝，有危险或意外时及时提醒我，并告诉我需要处理的情况。
query.text_en: Please watch over the baby. Alert me promptly to danger or an accident and tell me what needs attention.

annotation.text_zh: 地毯有褶皱，小心宝宝绊倒。
annotation.text_en: The rug is bunched up, so watch out so the baby doesn't trip.

annotation.text_zh: 宝宝摔倒哭了，快去抱抱他。
annotation.text_en: The baby fell and is crying, go give them a hug.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
